 No Trash, Composting, or Recycling Collection on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026
 October 27, 2026 
 The New York City Department of Sanitation announced that in observance of Election Day, there will be NO trash, composting, nor recycling collection on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
 Residents who normally receive Tuesday trash, composting, or recycling collection may place their material at the curb Tuesday evening for collection beginning Wednesday, November 4.
 NOTE FOR ALL RESIDENTS: Collection delays may occur after a holiday. We appreciate patience as we work to collect the backlog of material.
 For questions about Sanitation services and holiday schedules contact 311 or visit nyc.gov/sanitation .
 Press Release #26-43
